scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter "@vortex/*" --filter "@nexusmods/*" --filter "./packages/**" --filter "!@vortex/e2e" --filter "!vortex-api" -r run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:extensions && pnpm run assets
scripts.build:extensions: pnpm run api && pnpm --filter "./extensions/**" run build
scripts.assets: npx tsx scripts/download-duckdb-extensions.ts && node ./scripts/dependency-report.mjs && node ./InstallAssets.mjs ./src/main/build && pnpm sass --style compressed --silence-deprecation=import ./src/stylesheets/loadingScreen.scss ./src/main/build/assets/css/loadingScreen.css && pnpm tailwindcss -i ./src/stylesheets/tailwind-v4.css -o ./src/main/build/assets/css/tailwind-v4.css -m
scripts.dist: pnpm run build:all && pnpm --filter "./src/*" -r run dist
scripts.package: pnpm run dist && pnpm -F @vortex/main run package
scripts.package:nosign: pnpm run dist && pnpm -F @vortex/main run package:nosign
scripts.package:local: pnpm -F @vortex/main run prepare:win && pnpm run package:nosign
